snippet.title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - PC Features Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the PC specs with the Limited Time Demo Available Now! Experience both provinces of Latium and Albion from September 2nd to the 16th.

Play Demo now 👉 https://register.ubisoft.com/anno117_pax_romana-demo
 
Experience the PC capabilities of Anno 117: Pax Romana as the provinces of Latium and Albion are brought to life in stunning detail, with 4K resolution, ultra-wide support, ray tracing, a breathtaking day-night cycle, and much more!
 
Anno 117: Pax Romana is available November 13, 2025 📜

FOLLOW US ON:
Web: anno-union.com
Instagram: @annogame 
Facebook: facebook.com/annogame/
Twitter: twitter.com/ANNO_EN

#Anno117PaxRomana #Anno117 #Anno  #Anno117Preorder 

About Anno 117: Pax Romana:
In the latest instalment of the award-winning Anno strategy franchise, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture? 
The cost of peace is yours to decide.

About Ubisoft:
Ubisoft is a creator of worlds, committed to enriching players’ lives with original and memorable entertainment experiences. Ubisoft’s global teams create and develop a deep and diverse portfolio of games, featuring brands such as Assassin’s Creed®, Brawlhalla®, For Honor®, Far Cry®, Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon®, Just Dance®, Rabbids®, Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six®, The Crew® and Tom Clancy’s The Division®. With a Ubisoft+ subscription, players can access new releases, premium editions and extra content on Day One on PC, console and cloud. For the 2024-25 fiscal year, Ubisoft generated net bookings of €1.85 billion. To learn more, please visit: www.ubisoftgroup.com.
